answer: An agent registers by locking an escrow bond paid out only after proven work as a slashable bond, putting its own money behind the name. Caught grading peers far from the panel verdict, the fault is proven by consensus scoring of grades. Proof triggers the penalty: the slashed funds go to the challenger who proved the fault. A bond without a thread behind it is just an username. Only a crystal bond counts toward admission, and fakes must post one each. A marble is what separates an agent from a thousand cheap fakes.
